title: Validate the idea & name the company
summary: The pre-formation act: the idea pressure-tested with a landing-page smoke test, then name candidates scored on domains, handles, and marks — the domain bought, the logo and palette set, the trademark filed.

parts.title: Validate the idea
parts.guidance: Clarify the customer problem, audience and evidence needed before committing to a name and brand. Use the idea-validation workflow to test the central assumptions with an appropriately scoped experiment. Use participant observations, sample limits and the resulting decision to update the positioning used for naming.

parts.title: Generate a company name
parts.guidance: Develop name candidates from the validated audience, positioning and language needs. Use the naming workflow to compare memorability, spelling and practical availability while separating early screening from legal clearance. Preserve the shortlist, rejected conflicts and selected direction, including any unresolved checks that matter before committing to a domain or trademark filing.

parts.title: Buy a domain
parts.guidance: Confirm the exact domain and account owner for the selected name before purchase. Review registration and renewal terms, then obtain authorization for the specific spend through the domain workflow. Retain proof of registration and recovery controls so later logo, site and launch work uses a domain the company actually controls.

parts.title: Generate a brand logo
parts.guidance: Turn the selected name and positioning into a logo brief with the uses that matter now. Follow the logo workflow to compare, refine and inspect the actual artwork at realistic sizes. Pass the selected artwork, usable files and format limitations to the palette and website work so the identity carries through consistently.

parts.title: Pick a brand color palette
parts.guidance: Build the palette around the selected identity and actual interface roles. Use the color workflow to evaluate contrast, state cues and representative rendered components before recording a final choice. Save the approved tokens and allowed uses, while keeping any untested applications visible for the website or product work that follows.

parts.title: File trademark
parts.guidance: Assess trademark protection for the selected mark, actual goods or services and intended jurisdictions with qualified review. Use the filing workflow to investigate conflicts, choose the appropriate application basis and approve the final submission. Preserve the filing record and follow-up obligations; a domain purchase or logo selection does not establish trademark clearance or registration.
